name: How is a sewer line located?

mainEntity.name: How is a sewer line located?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process of locating a sewer line involves a trained technician inserting a flexible rod with a camera and a radio transmitter into your sewer pipe, typically through a cleanout access point. As the camera travels through the pipe, the transmitter sends out a signal. Above ground, the technician uses a receiver to detect this signal, allowing them to accurately trace the pipe's exact location and depth. This method is non-invasive and provides real-time mapping of your sewer system's layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: A camera with a radio transmitter is inserted into the sewer line, and a technician uses a receiver above ground to trace its exact path and depth.
